title: Moss and the Gravel Path
checkpoint: Phase 5 continues (School readiness) — new alternative pronunciations u as yoo, c as s, g as j.
note_for_grown_ups: Phase 5 continues (School readiness) — new alternative pronunciations u as yoo, c as s, g as j.

pages.text: Moss looks at Mum rake the gravel path.
pages.illustration: Moss the hedgehog watching an older hedgehog raking small stones into neat lines on a gravel path.

pages.text: Mum makes neat lines in the gravel.
pages.illustration: A close-up of neat, even lines raked into the grey gravel.
Moss the hedgehog reaching for a small rake leaning against the fence.

pages.text: Moss rakes, but the lines bend and dip.
pages.illustration: Moss the hedgehog raking with wobbly, crooked lines appearing in the gravel.

pages.text: Moss frowns at the bent lines.
pages.illustration: Moss the hedgehog looking down at his uneven lines with a small frown.

pages.text: Mum helps Moss grip the rake flat.
pages.illustration: The older hedgehog guiding Moss’s paws, helping him hold the rake flat and steady.

pages.text: Moss tries again, bit by bit.
pages.illustration: Moss the hedgehog raking slowly and carefully, a new neat line forming.

pages.text: This time the lines sit flat.
pages.illustration: A tidy row of straight lines now visible in the gravel where Moss has raked.

pages.text: Moss grins at his neat path.
pages.illustration: Moss the hedgehog smiling at the neat gravel path he has just finished.

pages.text: Moss is proud of the path.
pages.illustration: Moss the hedgehog and the older hedgehog standing together, looking at the tidy gravel path.
